overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that content centered around 'self respect' and digital/phone boundaries (chat deletion, pinning, status, keyboards) consistently outperforms broader emotional themes like 'अधूरी मोहब्बत' or general 'रात के ख्याल' in terms of view counts. However, overall view numbers remain in the low double digits, signaling a need to refine hook potency and emotional tension while doubling down on the proven sub-niche of phone-related self-respect moments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Digital boundary/phone action hooks for self-respect
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Self Respect Status | Jab Aapko Fark Padhna Band Hoge Jaaye' (32 views), 'Self Respect Story... चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views), and 'Self Respect Status Story... स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर' (41 views) perform better than abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Focus future scripts on micro-interactions with mobile interfaces (e.g., call logs, mute buttons, notification settings) representing emotional detachment.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract atmospheric late-night poetry without a tangible anchor
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (6 views) and 'ओवरथिंकिंग और अधूरी उम्मीद की एक शांत कहानी' (8 views) received significantly lower traction.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely conceptual poetry openings; ground every emotional thought in a specific, physical daily action.

next_video.concept: A realization moment when disabling read receipts (blue ticks) or turning off notification pop-ups for a specific contact brings ultimate peace rather than anxiety.
next_video.opening_direction: जब सेटिंग्स में जाकर 'Read Receipts' का टॉगल हमेशा के लिए ऑफ कर दिया,
next_video.twist_direction: डर था कि शायद अब कोई मैसेज नहीं आएगा, पर सुकून ये था कि अब किसी के ऑनलाइन होने का इंतज़ार भी खत्म हो गया।
next_video.reason: Aligns directly with the top-performing 'self respect' and 'chat/notification setting' patterns that generated peak views in past batches.

experiment: Testing a slightly longer duration (15s vs 10s) paired with a settings-adjustment hook to see if increased retention translates to higher view velocity.
